items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: under Professor Chalini I enjoyed my music very much... I had to go to lessons.

ctx.x: Yeah I remember another funeral parlor on St. Philip too.

That's right. But under Professor Chalini I enjoyed my music very much. As a matter of fact I didn't get as much out of it as I should have or I could have because at that particular time, being the youngster you know you always come home from school, throw your books on the couch or the machine and you go out and play some ball, football or baseball or basketball or something of that particular nature, until I was reminded of the fact that I had to go to lessons.
